ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, taking points A and B as the centers respectively, arcs are drawn with radii greater than $\frac{1}{2}AB$ and intersecting at points M and N. Line $MN$ is drawn, intersecting $BC$ at point D. $AD$ is connected. If the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is $17$ and $AB=7$, what is the perimeter of $\triangle ADC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: From the method, we know: MN is the perpendicular bisector of AB,\\
$\therefore$AD=BD,\\
$\because$ The perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is 17 and AB=7,\\
$\therefore$AC+BC=10,\\
$\therefore$ The perimeter of $\triangle ADC$ is:\\
AC+CD+AD=AC+CD+BD=AC+BC=\boxed{10}
